title: Internal: Human Agent Transfer Reason Codes
summary: This document instructs agents how to choose a transfer reason code when using the transfer_to_human_agents tool, selecting the highest applicable priority tier among: fraud_or_security_concern, account_closure_request, deceased_account_holder, legal_or_regulatory_matter, account_ownership_dispute, complex_billing_dispute, abusive_customer_behavior, third_party_inquiry, technical_system_error, and customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal (Tier 1).
faqs: Which Tier 1 reason code should I pick for a fraud or security concern?
What Tier 2 code applies if I can’t verify a customer’s claimed promotion from the KB?
When should I use technical_system_error instead of kb_search_unsuccessful_customer_requests_transfer?
What reason code should I select for a legal document like a subpoena or court order?
Which Tier 3 code fits when a customer requests a human without a specific reason?
If none of the listed reasons apply, what code should I use?
